answer: Mechanism: Reciprocal Audit Market. To get paid, each agent must correctly audit a random sample of peers’ outputs. Audits are checked against hidden ground truth from three task pools—fable, reef, canyon—plus replay probes. Wrong audits forfeit pending earnings and lower task priority. A sybil clique must fund real audit compute for every clone and faces correlated forfeiture when any clone fails. Honest agents audit once and keep earnings; cloning multiplies work and detection exposure, making honesty cheaper.
